summary.text: Dan Laughlin is a Republican member of the Pennsylvania Senate who represents the 49th Senatorial District, which includes nearly all of Erie County.
He was elected in 2016, reelected in 2020 and 2024, and chairs the Senate Law and Justice Committee.

paragraphs.text: Laughlin was born in Erie and raised in the Erie Heights housing project, according to his official biography, and is the son of a World War II combat veteran who worked as a union carpenter.
He joined his brother's construction firm and later bought into the company as a full partner; Laughlin Builders was one of the region's premier home builders.

Twenty years later the brothers formed the trash disposal company Waste Away, which they later sold, and their portfolio grew to include an insulating firm, Clear Water Foam, and a rental company, Laughlin Properties.

In the Senate, he is vice chairman of the Game and Fisheries Committee and a member of the Environmental Resources and Energy, Finance, Health & Human Services, Labor and Industry, and Rules and Executive Nominations committees.
He is also the Senate representative on the Advisory Council of the Pennsylvania Soldiers' and Sailors' Home in Erie.
He is married to the former Peggy Schneider, and they have three children.
